scientific_question: Does the exact installed SM89 CUTLASS FP8 raw path at Gemma's six fused linear shapes falsify the L40S c12 planning or conservative service ceiling after an independent attention/KV residual floor is merged?
semantics: Checkpoint-free deterministic execution proxy only; no model quality, endpoint fit, throughput, reliability, or deployability claim.
mechanical_precreate_gate: Director must recompute PROJECT.md, START_PACKET.json, FINAL_STAGED_PROGRAM_AUDIT.json, STAGED_MANIFEST.json, program/wrapper/source-manifest and shared lifecycle hashes; assert exact image/model/GPU and empty provider inventory. Any mismatch closes before create.

lifecycle.ownership: one bounded durable local systemd owner wrapping one sequential placement_control.VerifiedRetainedOwner; one watchdog; no support successor
lifecycle.allocation: one lowercase l40s preemptible instance plus one 100 GiB network SSD; one create; no repair/restart

conditional.arm: all six M12 and M3679 exact-shape rows

lifecycle.trigger: Only after the shared controller has atomically retrieved and parsed the primary stage-terminal: stage==primary, terminal.pass==true, result.type==gemma4_exact_shape_direct_cutlass_fp8, result.sentinel.pass==true, exact runtime/source identity pass, and >=12 provider minutes remain. Otherwise cleanup immediately.
lifecycle.cleanup: VerifiedRetainedOwner context exit deletes the named instance/disk and requires authenticated final inventory zero before terminal acceptance.

acceptance.sentinel: one row, dual oracle pass, positive/stable CUDA+wall distributions, exact identity, telemetry acceptance, retrieved before conditional starts
acceptance.sweep: exactly 12 rows; all dual oracles and distributions pass; exact aggregation emitted; telemetry accepted
acceptance.decision: If linear_plus_residual_floor exceeds a ceiling, that L40S c12 economic envelope is falsified. If it is below, record survival of this lower bound only and do not admit FP8 or an endpoint.
acceptance.stop_rule: Stop and clean on any identity/source/hash/oracle/timing/telemetry/shape failure; after one valid sweep terminal clean immediately regardless of outcome.

adjacent_followup.name: full six-shape conditional sweep
adjacent_followup.why: It is staged before create and reuses only the retained image/runtime after the independently retrieved sentinel. No W4 arm is retained because its raw packing/oracle path is not equally bound.

w4.reason: No equally source-bound raw Marlin WNA16 packing and dual-oracle program was available within ten minutes; omission is fail-closed.
